name: Dragon Flame
description: The flaming dragon loves adventure and freedom, and has a naughty personality. The thick scales covering its body are its protective umbrella and source of energy. Its sharp teeth, powerful limbs, and flexible dragon tail are its powerful weapons in life; its sharp claws, the flames it spurts when angry, and its huge wings like bat wings are its biggest highlights. It likes to soar high in the sky during the day, looking for partners on the ground to play with; at night, it likes to stand quietly on the edge of the cliff and look up at the vast starry sky.
